headings.usage: Hero titles, section headers, hotel names

grids_and_layouts.general: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-16 for structural padding. Mobile-first grids. Asymmetric layouts for marketing pages.
grids_and_layouts.marketing_bento: Use 12-column bento grids for hotel features. Mix image spans (col-span-8) with content spans (col-span-4).
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: High density grid (grid-cols-4 or grid-cols-12). gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. Cardless or max 8px radius with 1px border. Full height children.

surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E5E0D5]/50. NEVER fully transparent.
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.footer: Dark mode contrast: bg-[#1A1A1A] text-[#FDFBF7] with massive spacing py-24. High typographic contrast.
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.hotel_cards: Tactile Neumorphism: Flat bg #FFFFFF, 1px border #E5E0D5, subtle ambient shadow. On hover: -translate-y-1, shadow-lg, border-[#6B1D2A]/30. Nested radii (child image radius <= parent card radius).
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.admin_panels: Grid borders / Technical look: border-collapse style layouts with border-r and border-b in subtle #E5E0D5.

motion.hover_states: Subtle lifts (-translate-y-1) and shadow expansions for clickable cards. Color transitions (200ms ease) for buttons.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slide up (using framer-motion). Staggered entrance animations for hotel lists.
motion.micro_interactions: Button active scale (0.98), subtle background color shifts.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Text on images MUST have text-shadow or a dark gradient overlay.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Use aria-hidden on purely decorative elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='book-hotel-button').

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for marketing, slightly rounded (rounded-md) for admin. Primary is bg-[#6B1D2A] text-white. Secondary is outline border-[#E5E0D5] text-[#1A1A1A].
components.forms: Use Shadcn/UI (Form, Input, Select, DatePicker) customized with bg-[#FFFFFF], focus:border-[#6B1D2A]. Left align all labels.
components.tables: Shadcn Table for Admin booking lists. Subtle row hover effects bg-[#1A1A1A]/5.
components.modals: Shadcn Dialog with backdrop-blur-md overlay. No fully transparent overlays.
components.toasts: Use Sonner for payment success/failure and form submissions.

images.description: Orchestra and choir performing. Use as main hero visual with a dark or burgundy gradient overlay.
Historic German cityscape. Use in 'About the Festival' or 'Destination' section.
Luxurious 4-star hotel room. Use as cover image for hotel listings.
Diverse choir members singing. Perfect for community or 'Who is this for?' section.

3d_and_creative_libraries.usage: Use Framer Motion for 2.5D Parallax effects on scroll for the hero section and staggered entrance animations for the hotel lists. No heavy WebGL/Three.js needed for this classical/elegant context.

icons_and_assets.style: Clean, thin stroke (stroke-width: 1.5). DO NOT use emojis for icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Generate React (.jsx/.js) code, NOT .tsx. Strip typescript types from Shadcn configurations if copying manually.
DO NOT output raw HTML for complex components (Datepickers, Dropdowns); ALWAYS use Shadcn.
NEVER use generic placeholder text; implement actual structured mock data (hotel names, prices, dates) matching the context of Halle, Germany.
For the bilingual feature, set up a React context for i18n, default to German but provide English translation objects.
Integrate a robust invoice UI mimicking the PDF generation structure in the admin dashboard.
Implement 'framer-motion' for entrance animations (staggered lists of hotels) to bring the design to life.
Ensure total mobile responsiveness (images max-h-[80vh] on mobile).
Adhere to 'Old Money Tech' archetype: use Playfair Display for big headings, Manrope for readable dense text.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grid and bento boxes.
Create depth via layered design and glassmorphism.
MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Avoid AI emojis. Use lucide-react icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical defaults.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit').
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface with content underneath.
